text:
Noah G: Tiny idea for next week: a 'Hallway High-Five' sticker drop. leave a sticker on a teammate's laptop or desk with a one-line note. low-cost, short interaction.
Ava (People Ops): Love the energy. How many stickers are we thinking? which zones?
Priya S: I'd suggest 200 stickers so we can cover two floors and a few team pods. Also a short sticker peel card so folks can grab quickly.
Maya L: I can design a tiny round sticker that says "High-Five" + a place to write a name. minimal branding.
Noah G: Timing idea: Tuesday morning 9-11 to catch people as they settle in. Also a small table by the north corridor for pick-up.
FacilitiesBot: Need to reserve a small table and sign holder. Ticket #8812 logged. ETA approval: same day if submitted by noon.
Ava (People Ops): Budget ok up to $80 for stickers and sign holders. We'll use internal print for a same-day turnaround. Priya, can you manage volunteer slots?
Priya S: Yep. I'll make a 15-min volunteer sheet slots: setup 8:45, two shifts 9:00-10:00 and 10:00-11:00, and takedown 11:00-11:15.
Maya L: Poster copy idea: "Hallway High-Five — Pick a sticker, write a one-line thanks, stick it on a desk to make someone's day. Tuesday 9-11, North Corridor."
Noah G: Also propose a quick note to managers: encourage teams to let folks take a 2-min break to pop by. Ava, can you send manager nudge?
Ava (People Ops): Sure. I'll send a 1-line manager nudge with sample phrasing and link to volunteer sign-up.
KudosBot: Suggest adding a QR to collect digital shoutouts for remote folks; I can generate a small shortlink.
Noah G: Good call. Let's include a tiny QR on the sign that goes to a one-line nomination form.
Priya S: Volunteer list: Noah (8:45-9:30 setup + shift), Maya (9:30-10:30), Priya (10:30-11:15 takedown). Need one more for 9:00-10:00.
Ava (People Ops): I'll cover the 9:00-10:00 slot. Also will queue a small runbook in this thread: pickup location, table placement, sticker box count, QR shortlink, volunteer contact numbers.
Maya L: I'll upload sticker art and the sign PDF tonight. Using a peel-card layout to speed distribution.
FacilitiesBot: Table reserved: North Corridor by glass wall. Sign holder available.
Noah G: One operational note: include a small bin for used pens and a hand sanitizer pump. I'll bring both.
Ava (People Ops): Great. Final checklist: stickers printed, table reserved, volunteers set, QR link live, manager nudge queued. We'll run as a one-time pilot and collect quick feedback. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
Noah G: Excited. I'll post a short photos thread after to capture moments.
KudosBot: Reminder queued: collect volunteer feedback form 24h after event.
Ava (People Ops): Perfect. If anything blocks, flag here or DM me directly.
